claims.text: Many reviewers say the suction is strong and effectively removes blackheads and whiteheads.
Several reviewers note that following the instructions and starting on the lowest level helps avoid marks, rash, or redness.
A few reviewers report that the suction is too weak to clear pores, contrary to the product's claims.
Some reviewers mention a gift card offered in exchange for a 5-star review, which they describe as a scam.
Some reviewers say it does not remove everything every time and works best after a hot shower.

qa.q: Will this work on sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it caused severe bruising or red marks on sensitive skin [1][3], while others with sensitive skin found it worked well [2][4]. One reviewer noted it was gentler than pinching but could only use lower settings [6].

claims.text: One reviewer with sensitive skin reported severe bruising from the device [1].
Some reviewers said it can leave a red mark on people with sensitive skin [3].
Other reviewers with sensitive skin said it worked well for them [2][4].
One reviewer found it gentler than pinching but could only use it on lower settings [6].

qa.q: Does it actually remove blackheads effectively?
qa.answer: Reviews report it removes blackheads effectively, though several note it doesn't remove everything every time [1][2][3][4][6]. Reviewers say it works best after softening skin with a hot shower or warm water [4][5].

claims.text: It pulled out so much from the nose and worked better than a nose strip [1][6].
It removed some but not all blackheads, and doesn't remove everything every time [2][4].
It works best after a hot shower or washing with warm water [4][5].
